return policy: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery. The item must be unused, in its original packaging, and accompanied by a receipt or proof of purchase.
refund policy: Once we receive and inspect your returned item, we will notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund. Approved refunds will be processed and automatically applied to your original method of payment within 5-7 business days.
shipping time: Standard shipping typically takes 3-5 business days. Expedited shipping is available at checkout and usually takes 1-2 business days.
cash on delivery: Yes, we offer Cash on Delivery (COD) for eligible locations. Please check the availability for your ZIP code at checkout.
payment methods: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, JazzCash, EasyPaisa, and Cash on Delivery (COD) for eligible areas.
order cancellation: You can cancel your order within 24 hours of placing it, provided it has not yet been shipped. Please contact our support team immediately to request a cancellation.
exchange policy: If you need to exchange an item for a different size or color, please initiate a return for the original item and place a new order for the preferred item.
warranty: All our electronics and appliances come with a standard 1-year manufacturer warranty. Please refer to the specific product page for detailed warranty terms.
delivery charges: Standard delivery is free for orders over PKR 5,000. For orders under PKR 5,000, a flat rate of PKR 150 applies. Expedited delivery charges vary based on weight and destination.
contact support: You can reach our customer support team via email at support@store.com, or call us at 0300-1234567. Our working hours are Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 6 PM.
how to track my order: Once your order is shipped, you will receive a tracking ID via SMS and email. You can also ask our AI assistant 'Track order [your order ID]' to get real-time status.
order not received: If your order has not arrived after the estimated delivery date, please contact our support team with your order ID. We will investigate and provide a resolution within 24 hours.
wrong item received: If you received the wrong item, please contact support within 48 hours of delivery with your order ID and a photo of the item received. We will arrange a free replacement or full refund.
damaged item received: If your item arrived damaged, please report it within 48 hours with photos. We will arrange a free replacement or process a full refund without requiring you to return the damaged item.
order status meanings: Pending: Order placed, awaiting confirmation. Processing: Order confirmed and being prepared. Shipped: Package handed to courier. Delivered: Package delivered to your address. Cancelled: Order was cancelled.
product availability: Product availability is shown on each product page. If an item shows 'Out of Stock', you can use the 'Notify Me' feature to receive an alert when it becomes available again.
how to search products: You can search for products by typing the product name or category in the chat. For example, say 'Show me laptops' or 'Browse electronics' to get started.
product categories: We offer products across multiple categories including Electronics, Mobile Phones, Laptops, Fashion, Footwear, Men's Watches, Women's Bags, Beauty & Personal Care, Home Appliances, Gaming, and more.
product reviews: Customer reviews are visible on each product page. Reviews are verified and submitted by customers who have purchased the product. You can filter by star rating to find the most relevant reviews.
how to compare products: To compare products, ask our assistant to show you products in a specific category. You can then ask about the price and rating of specific items for comparison.
budget recommendations: You can ask our assistant for recommendations within your budget. For example: 'Recommend me something under PKR 10,000 in electronics' and we will show you the best options.
best selling products: Our best sellers vary by category. You can ask 'Show me popular products in [category]' to see top-rated items. Products with a rating above 4.5 are generally considered best sellers.
new arrivals: New products are added to our inventory regularly. Ask our assistant 'What are the latest products in [category]?' to see newly added items.
bundle deals: We occasionally offer bundle deals and combo packs. Check the Discounts section or ask 'Are there any bundle deals available?' to see current promotions.
how to cancel after shipping: If your order has already been shipped, it may not be possible to cancel. You can refuse the delivery and it will be returned to us. Once received, we will process a full refund within 5-7 business days.
partial order cancellation: If you ordered multiple items, you can cancel individual items before shipping by contacting our support team. Provide your order ID and the specific item you wish to cancel.
cancellation refund timeline: For cancelled orders where payment was made online, refunds are processed within 3-5 business days back to your original payment method. COD orders with no payment made are cancelled instantly.
failed payment: If your payment failed but the amount was deducted from your account, please wait 24 hours as it usually reverses automatically. If it does not reverse, contact support with your bank transaction ID.
payment security: All payments are processed through secure, PCI-DSS compliant payment gateways. We use SSL encryption to protect your card and personal information. We never store your full card details.
credit card payment: We accept Visa, MasterCard, and American Express credit cards. Your card is charged only after order confirmation. 3D Secure authentication may be required for additional security.
jazzcash easypaisa: JazzCash and EasyPaisa mobile wallet payments are available at checkout. Simply select your preferred wallet, enter your registered mobile number, and confirm the payment via OTP.
invoice and receipt: A digital receipt is emailed to you after every successful order. You can also request an invoice by contacting our support team with your order ID.
free shipping: We offer free standard shipping on all orders above PKR 5,000. Orders below this threshold attract a flat delivery fee of PKR 150.
shipping across pakistan: Yes, we deliver to all major cities and towns across Pakistan including Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Quetta, and more.
express delivery: Express delivery (next-day or same-day) is available in select cities. Please check availability at checkout by entering your delivery address.
international shipping: Currently, we only ship within Pakistan. International shipping is not available at this time, but we are working to expand our delivery network.
delivery not on time: If your delivery is delayed beyond the estimated date, please contact support with your order ID. We will escalate the issue with our courier partner and provide you with an update.
change delivery address: Delivery address can be changed only before the order is shipped. Please contact support as soon as possible with your order ID and new address.
loyalty program: Yes, we have a rewards program where you earn points on every purchase. Points can be redeemed for discounts on future orders. Ask about your current points balance by contacting support.
create account: To create an account, click 'Sign Up' on our website or mobile app. You will need to provide your name, email address, and phone number. Account creation is free.
privacy policy: We take your privacy seriously. Your personal data is never sold to third parties. We collect only the information necessary to process your orders and improve your shopping experience.
data deletion: You can request deletion of your account and all associated personal data by emailing privacy@store.com. Requests are processed within 30 days in compliance with applicable data protection laws.
store hours: Our online store is available 24/7. Customer support is available Monday to Saturday from 9 AM to 6 PM. Responses to email queries are sent within one business day.
business account: For bulk purchases or business accounts, please contact our B2B team at business@store.com. We offer special pricing, dedicated account managers, and priority support for business clients.
gift cards: Gift cards are available in denominations of PKR 500, 1,000, 2,500, and 5,000. They can be purchased online and redeemed at checkout. Gift cards do not expire.
size guide: Size guides for clothing and footwear are available on individual product pages. We recommend checking the size chart before ordering to ensure the best fit.
how to raise a complaint: You can raise a complaint by asking our AI assistant 'I want to raise a ticket' or 'Create a support ticket'. You will be guided through the process step-by-step.
support ticket status: To check the status of your support ticket, contact us at support@store.com with your ticket ID. Our team will provide an update within one business day.
human agent: If you prefer to speak with a human agent, type 'Connect me to a human agent' or 'I need real help' in the chat. Your request will be escalated and a representative will contact you shortly.
app download: Our mobile app is available on Google Play Store (Android) and Apple App Store (iOS). Search for our store name to find and download the official app.
subscription cancellation: To cancel a subscription or membership, go to Account Settings in the app or website and select 'Manage Subscription'. You can also contact support for assistance.
product not as described: If a product does not match its description or photos on the website, please contact support within 7 days of delivery. We will arrange a return and full refund at no cost to you.
minimum order: There is no minimum order requirement. You can place an order for a single item. However, orders above PKR 5,000 qualify for free shipping.
discount codes: Promotional discount codes can be entered at checkout in the 'Promo Code' field. Codes are case-sensitive and can only be used once per account unless stated otherwise.
